m: अप-√ 3. मा (ind.p. -माय; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 4, 69) to measure off, measure, AV. xix, 57, 6.

s: klI, (apa + mA + BAve lyuw .) anAdaraH । amaryyAdA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ tatparyyAyaH । “syAdavajYA parIhAraH parihAraH parABavaH । apamAnaM pariBavastiraskArastirazkriyA । avahelA ca helA myAdavahelanahelane । kzepo nikAraDikkArO paryyAyaH syAdanAdare” ॥ iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ * ॥ tasya aprakASyatvaM yaTA, -- “arTanASaM manastApaM gfhe duScaritAni ca । vaYcanaYcApamAnaYca matimAnna prakASayet” ॥ iti cARakyaH ॥ (“apamAnaM puraskftya mAnaM kftvA tu pfzWataH । svakAryyamudDaret prAjYaH kAryyaDvaMse hi mUQatA”) ॥
v: pu॰ apakfzwaM mIyate'nena apa + mA--karaRe lyuW । anAdare “apamAnaM puraskftya svakAryyaM sADayennara” iti nItiH । “mAnApamAnayostulyastulyo mitrAripakzayo” riti” gItA । vedasya brAhmaRAnAYca apamAnAdaDogatiH purA॰ apakfzwo mAno yasmAt apa + mana--karaRe GaY vA । anAdare pu॰ । nApamAnaH prayoktavyaH kAmakroDakftaH kvaciditi” rAmA॰ । “aTApamAnena pituHprayukteti” kumA॰ ।
m: अप-मान m. (or n.), (√ मन्), disrespect, contempt, disgrace.
a: अपमानः — Disrespect, dishonour, disgrace; despising, slighting, contempt; लभते बुद्ध्यवज्ञानमपमानं च पुष्कलं Pt. 1. 63; समुद्रेण मम भृत्यस्यांडान्यपहृत्य मेऽपमानस्थानं कृतं Pt. 1.

m: अप-मानिन् mfn. dishonouring, despising.

v: tri॰ apamAnaM jAtamasya tAra॰ itac । yasyApamAnaM kftaM tasmin kftApamAne anAdfte ।
m: अप-मानित mfn. dishonoured, disgraced, ŚāṅkhGṛ. &c.
अप-मान्य mfn. disreputable, dishonourable.

v: pu॰ apakfzwo mArgaH prA॰ sa॰ vA kfzwalopaH । kutsitavartmani ।
m: 1. अप-मार्ग m. a by-way, Pañcat.
2. अप-मार्ग m. wiping off, cleaning, Śiś.
a: अपमार्गः — 1 A by-path, side way; a bad way. --2 Shampooing, rubbing &c. of the body (अंगपरिमार्जनं) Śi. 9. 36.

m: अप-मारिन् mfn. dying or pining away, TS.

v: na॰ apa + mfja--BAve lyuw vfdDiH । saMSoDane । “kAMsyApamArjanamasImaDuraM sEnDavaM natamiti” suSrutaH aDastAnmArjane ca । apamArjanaprokzitAByAmapamfzwa iti kAtyA॰ 9, 10, 4 । “apamArjanaMgrahapAtramuKAdAraByADastAdapamArjanamiti” tadvyA॰ ।
m: अप-मार्जन n. cleansing
a cleansing remedy, detergent, Suśr.
अप-मार्जन mfn. wiping off, moving away, destroying, BhP.
a: अपमार्जनं — 1 Wiping away, cleansing, purifying. --2 Shaving, paring. --3 Chips.

m: अप-मूर्धन् mfn. headless.

v: tri॰ apagato mUrdDA yasya । SiraHSUnye kabanDe ।

s: puM, (apakfzwatayA mIyate, apa + mA + GaYarTe kaH .) krAntiH । iti sidDAntaSiromaRO golADyAyaH ॥
v: tri॰ apakfzwaM mIyate apa + mA--bA॰ ka । apakfzwatayA jYAte “Bago'nASoScidavitA'pamasya cit” । f॰ 10, 39, 3 । “apamasya jAtyAtinikfzwasya” BA॰ । apakfzyaBUgolAdupari mIyate । BUgIlAnAcCAditAntarikzamAge jyotizapariBAzitAyAM sUryyAdigatyarTatiryyagreKAyAm krAntO yaTA । “nAqikAmaRqalAt tiryyagatrApamaH, krAntivfttAvaDiH krAntivfttAcCaraH । vikzepavfttAvaDistiryyagevaM sPuwo nAqikAvfttaKewAntarAle'pama” iti si॰ Si॰ । “krAntivftte yat sPuwagrahasTAnaM tasya nAqIvfttAt tiryyagantaram apamaH krAntiH । aTa vimaRqale yat grahasTAnaM tasya krAntivfttAt yat tiryyagantaraM sa vikzepaH aTa vimaRqalasya prAk ca nAqIvfttAt yat tiryyagantaram saH apamaH sPuwA krAntiH grahasya uttarato yAmyadiSaM yAmyAntAt tadanu sOmyadigBAgam । prami॰ “parisaratAM gaganasadAM calanaM kiYcidBavedapamaH” iti । si॰ Si॰ ।
m: अपम mfn. (fr. अप), the most distant, the last, RV. x, 39, 3; AV. x, 4, 1
अपम m. (in astron.) the declination of a planet.
a: अपम — a. [अपकृष्टं मीयते, मा बाहु˚ क] Ved. The most distant or remote, the last, lowest in caste, most degraded (जात्यातिनिकृष्ट). --मः (In astr.) Declination; the ecliptic; परिसरतां गगनसदां चलनं किंचिद्भवेदपमः Sid. Śir. --Comp. --ज्या the line of the ecliptic; see क्रांतिज्या. --मंडलं, --वृत्तं the ecliptic.

m: अप-मङ्गल mfn. inauspicious, Subh. (conj.).

v: na॰ apakrAntaM maRqalAt BUmaRqalAt nirA॰ ta॰ । sidDAntaSiromaRyukte krAntivftte । yaTA “grahasya gole kaTitA'pamaRqalaM prakalpya kakzAbalayaM yaToditamiti” “krAntivfttaM kakzAmaRqalaM prakalpyeti” pramitA॰ । “eza BagolaH kaTitaH Kecaragolo'yameva vijYeyaH । atrApasaRqale vA sUtrADArEva yasya tasyEveti” si॰ Si॰ ।

m: अपम-शिञ्जिनी f. = अपम-ज्या, Gaṇit.
अप-मद mfn. free from pride or arrogance, Kāv.

v: strI apamasya DanurAkftikzetrasya jyeva । krAntivfttAKyajIvAyAm । vivaraRam krAntijyASabde dfSyam ।
m: अपम—ज्या f. the sine of the declination.
अपम—क्षेत्र See क्रान्ति-क्षेत्र.
अप-मल mfn. spotless, clean, Śāntiś. (v.l.).
अपम—मण्डल (or अप-मण्डल) or -वृत्त, n. the ecliptic.

a: अपमन् — Caus. To disrespect, dishonour, despise.

m: अप-मन्यु mfn. free from grief.
अप-मर्श m. (√ मृश्), touching, grazing, Śāk. (v.l. for अभि-मर्श).
अप-मर्द m. (√ मृद्), what is swept away, dirt.
a: अपमर्दः — What is swept away, dust, dirt; हयहस्तिकरीषाभ्यामपमर्दः कृतो महान् Rām.

v: pu॰ apa + mfda--GaY । vimarddane “hayahastikarIzAByAmapamarddaH kftomahAniti” rAmA॰ ।

m: अप-√ मे cl. 1. Ā. -मयते (ind.p. -मित्य, or -माय) to be in debt to, owe, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 19, Sch.
अपमृग mfn. deerless (as a wood), VP.
अप-√ मृज् cl. 2. P. Ā. -मार्ष्टि (1. pl. -मृज्महे; Imper. 2. du. -मृजेथाम्) to wipe off, remove, AV.; ŚBr. &c.
a: अपमृज् — {c2c} P., {c10c} P. To wipe off, efface, blot or wipe out, remove.

s: puM, (apakfzwaH rogeRaH vinA mftyuH maraRaM karmmaDArayaH .) apaGAtamaraRaM । vinA rogeRa maraRaM । yaTA, -- “apamftyuBayaM nAsti mfto mokzamavApnuyAt” । iti devImAhAtmyakIlakaM ॥ yattu SudDitattve proktaM pakzimatsyamfgadaMzwriSfNginaKipatanAnaSanavajrAgnivizabanDajalapraveSAMstrakzatAdijanyamaraRaM tadevApamftyuriti suDIBirviBAvyaM ॥
v: pu॰ apakfzwaH duzwahetujanyatvena mftyurmaraRam । vizodbanDanAdihetuke mftyO । “apamftyuhetavaSca SudDipattve kOrmme darSitA yaTA “SfNgidaMzwrinaKivyAlavizavahnistriyA jalEH । AdarAt pariharttavyaH kurvan krIqAM mftastu yaH । nAgAnAM vipriyaM kurvan dagDaScApyaTa vidyutA । nigfhItaH svayaMrAjYA cOryyadozeRa kutracit । paradArAn ramantaSca dvezAttatpatiBirhatAH । asamAnESca saNkIrRREScARqAlAdyESca vigraham । kftvA tErnihatAstAMstu cARqAlAdIn samASritAH । gavAgnivizadAScEva pAzaRqAH krUrabudDayaH । kroDAt prAyaM vizaM vahniM SastramudbanDanaM jalam । girivfkzaprapAtaYca ye kurvanti narADamA” iti ।
m: अप-मृत्यु m. sudden or accidental death
a great danger or illness (from which a person recovers).
a: अपमृत्युः — [अपकृष्टो दुष्टहेतुजन्यत्वेन मृत्युः] 1 Sudden or untimely death, accidental or unnatural death; भर्तृसक्तोऽपमृत्युस्तस्य संचरति Pt. 4. --2 Any great danger, illness &c. from which a person, hopelessly given up for lost, recovers, quite contrary to expectation.

v: tri॰ na॰ apa + mfza--kta vAkye vAcye ni॰ । kzAnte vAkye । anyatra apamfzwamityeva soQe kzAnte parAmfzwe ca ।
m: अप-मृषित unintelligible (as a speech), Pāṇ. i, 2, 20, Sch.
a: अपमृषित — a. 1 Unintelligible, obscure as a वाक्य or speech. --2 Unbearable, not borne or liked (असोढ, अतितिक्षित); विहितं मयाद्य सदसीदमपमृषितमच्युतार्चनं . यस्य &c. Śi. 15. 46 (for the formation of the word see Malli.).

m: अप-मृष्ट mfn. wiped off, cleansed, VS. &c.
अप-मृष्टि f. wiping off, AV.; Anukr.
अप-मित्य See अप-√ मे.
अप-मित्य n. debt, AV. vi, 117, 1; ĀśvŚr.
a: अपमित्य — Ved. To be thrown away. --त्यं, --त्यकं Debt.

s: klI, (apamityapamAnaM svIkftya gfhyate, apa + meN praRimAne + ktvA tasya lyap, “mayateridanyatarasyAmiti AsyAne itak, tataH kan .) fRaM । iti halAyuDaH ॥
v: na॰ apamitya apamAnamaNgIkftya gfhyate kan । fRe

m: अप-म्लुक्त mfn. (√ म्लुच्), retired, hidden, RV. x, 52, 4.

v: na॰ apagataM parABUtaM muKam prA॰ ta॰ । parAvftte vadane prA॰ ba॰ gatalopaH । parAvfttavadanavati padArTe tri॰ ।
m: अप-मुख mfn. having the face averted, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 186
having an ill-formed face or mouth, ib.
a: अपमुख — a. 1 Having the face averted. --2 Ill-favoured, ill-looking. --खं ind. Without the face.

m: अप-मुखम् ind. except the face, &c., ib.
अप-मुद् mfn. joyless, pitiable, Śiś.
अप-√ म्यक्ष् (Imper. 2. sg. -म्यक्ष) to keep off from (abl.), RV. ii, 28, 6.
